## Observed (RUNNING, credentialed verify of PR #653, 2026-08-08)

Against the live dogfood service at revision 7aa82d8 (which carries the #654 fix, re-proven live in the same run: 654-namespace-scope-proof.sh 5/5 PASS), the #578 gate's capture-round-trip and checkpoint scenarios fail with:

```
"error":"session_start result did not prove exact Open Brain scope: namespace"
"status":"lost","durable":false,"direct_attempted":true
```

Setting OPENBRAIN_DELEGATE_NAMESPACE=1 with a delegating (ob-admin) token does NOT clear it — this is not a delegation-config gap.

## Root cause (verifier-reproduced at the provider)

`python/openbrain-memory/src/openbrain_memory/_runtime_validation.py:107-116` — #654 (PR #657) added the actionable mismatch message guarded by `if "namespace" in lane and served != namespace`. When the lane object carries NO `namespace` key at all, validation falls through to the generic error at ~line 735, which names `namespace` — a key the fix's own comment (lines 93-99) documents as "never a request key… no way to send". That is the dead-end-error class (Tightenings round 15, same family as #646 and #529's scope-proof complaints).
